summary: At most ten promise-producing functions are allowed; correctness is established through immediate invocation, input-indexed settlement records, wait-for-all behavior, and finite aggregate settlement rather than artificial asymptotic wall-clock tiers.

workload_bound.source_constraint: functions.length is between one and ten

replacement_checks.evidence: The implementation invokes each function once, attaches one fulfillment/rejection pair, writes one indexed result record per settlement, and increments one counter, for O(n) bookkeeping.
Authored schedules cover one and ten functions, immediate and tied settlements, out-of-order fulfillment, several rejections, a rejection preceding a slower fulfillment, and structured payloads.

The deterministic app adapter records all start times, the last settlement time, and every input-indexed fulfillment or rejection record so cases verify parallel start, wait-for-all behavior, ordering, and payload preservation.
The exact native promise source is remotely Accepted under the provider timeout, and every deterministic local schedule reaches a finite aggregate resolution.
